theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (d : ℝ) (s : Set X) (r : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (T : ℕ → ℕ → Set X), Tendsto r atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ k i, ediam (T k i) ≤ r k) → (∀ k, s ⊆ ⋃ i, T k i) → (μH[d] : Measure X) s ≤ liminf (fun k => ∑' i, ⨆ (_ : (T k i).Nonempty), ediam (T k i) ^ d) atTop
